name: Open Exceptions
description: Count of exception cases currently open (not yet closed).

name: Critical Signals
description: Count of signals at critical or high severity that have not yet been reviewed away.

name: Pending Decisions
description: Count of Decisions currently awaiting supervisor/QC approval.

name: Exceptions by Severity
description: Count of exception cases grouped by severity.

name: Exceptions by Process Stage
description: Count of exception cases grouped by the process-stage observation of their triggering event.

name: Weekly Deviation Trend
description: Count of confirmed QC deviation events per week, used to visualise the escalating pattern over time.

name: Cases at SLA Risk
description: Exception cases at risk of breaching their implicit review/disposition SLA given time already elapsed without a decision.

name: Repeated Deviation Rate
description: Share of confirmed deviations that are part of a repeated/pattern signal rather than an isolated one-off.

name: Time to Disposition
description: Average elapsed time from a confirmed QC deviation to an approved disposition decision.

name: Output Awaiting Decision
description: Count of held batches whose disposition decision has not yet been approved.

name: Incomplete Investigations
description: Count of exception cases that carry at least one insufficient-evidence observation still blocking a confident finding.

name: Recent Case Activity
description: A short feed of the most recent exception-case events and signals, for the activity-feed widget.

name: Supplier Lot Exposure Outlook
description: Illustrative, non-authoritative narrative summarising exposure if the pending hold-affected-output decision remains unresolved. Always hypothetical; never presented as a measured value.
